chapter.verse: Kumpite a thahna panin a ciahkik Abraham dawn a, thupha a piak khit ciangin,

Abraham in a ngah sum khempeuh seh sawm suah seh khat khenin a piak, Salem Kumpipa ahi, Sang Bel Pasian’ Siampi Melkhizedek in, a min bulpi a khiatna pen dikna’ Kumpipa, tua tham loin, nopsakna’ Kumpipa a cihnopna, Salem Kumpipa hi a,
pa om lo, nu om lo, a suan a khak om lo, a nuntakna kipatna ahi zongin, a beina ahi zongin nei loin, Pasian’ Tapa tawh kibangin siampi-in a tawntungin a om hi.
I pu Abraham in a sum ngah ahoih bel seh sawm suah seh khat pia-a a sang tua pa in bang zah a lian na lunggai un.
Levi’ tate lakah siampi za a ngahte in Abraham’ suante ahi uh a, amau unaute’ khut tung uh panin Thukham mah bangin seh sawm suah seh khat a san’ nadingun thu a ngah uh hi.
Ahih hangin amau pawl hi lo, tua pa in Abraham’ khut tung pan seh sawm suah seh khat sang a, thuciamna a ngah mi zong thupha a pia hi.
Milian in mi neute thupha a piakna thu nial nading a om kei hi.
Tua tham loin, a si thei mite in tu lai takin seh sawm suah seh khat a sang uh hi. Tua lai takin ahih leh, a nungta hi ci-in teci pan’na a ngah mi in seh sawm suah seh khat a ngah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin seh sawm suah seh khat a ngah theipa Levi in Abraham tung pan seh sawm suah seh khat a pia hi ci-in gen ding thu a om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Melkhizedek in Abraham a dawn lai takin Levi in ama pupi’ pumpi sungah a om lai hi.

Lam khat panin, Levi’ suan siampi pawlte tawh kizomin mite in Thukham a ngah uh ciangin tua mi pawlte hangin kicin’na a om leh, adang siampi in Aaron’ pawl bangin kisam loin Melkhizedek’ pawl hong pian’ nading thu bang hangin om lai ding ahi hiam?
Siampi pawl kikheel ahih leh, Thukham zong kikheel loin a om thei kei ding hi.
Tua thu genkholhna tawh kipawl mi in biakna tau-ah khatvei beek na a sem ngei lo pawl sung pan a piang hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite Topa in Judah pawl sung pan hong piang hi ci-in a kilang hi. Tua pawl thu-ah siampite thu Moses in kam khat beek a gen kei hi.
Tua tham loin, Melkhizedek bangin adang siampipa a piang zo ahih leh, a tungah laigelhna in a maan ahihna a kilang zaw hi.
Tua siampi in pum tawh kipawl ngeina thu bang hi loin, a nungta tawntung vangliatna bangin kikoihin a om hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh: “Nang in Melkhizedek’ pawl bangin A tawntung Siampipa na hi hi,” ci-in teci a pang hi.
Thukham in bangmah kicingsak zo lo ahih ciangin tanglai thukham in thahatna nei lo a, phattuamna pia zo lo ahih ciangin paihkhiatna a ngah zo hi.
Ahih hangin tua sang a phazaw lametna thu hong piangsak hi. Tua lametna tawh eite in Pasian i nai thei hi.
Tua mite in kiciamna om loin siampi-za a ngah uh hi.

Zeisu ahih leh, kiciamna om loin a ngah kei hi. “Topa in, ‘Nang in a tawntung siampi na hi,’ ci-in ciamin a lungsim kikheel nawn lo ding hi,” ci-in thu a koihkholh mah bangin Zeisu in kiciamna tawh siampi za ngah a, a phazaw ciamna thu kikhapna a suak hi.
Tuate in si-in a kip tawntung zawh loh man-inah a tampi siampi a suak uh hi.
Zeisu ahih leh, a tawntung kip ahih ciangin a kikheel ngei lo siampi-za a ngah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu hangin Pasian kiangah a naite’ taang a, a thuum dingin Topa in a nungta tawntung ahih ciangin, a tawntungin hong gum thei hi.
Tua bang siampi ukpa in siangtho-in, dikin, kihhuaina om loin, mawhneite tawh kikhen khia a, vante sangin a sangzaw munah a tung mi ahih ciangin, eite ading a kilawm hi.

Siampi ukpa dangte in, a masa-in amau mawhna uh taang ding ahi zongin, tua nung ciangin midangte mawhna –uh taang ding ahi zongin, nisimin biakna a piak uh bangin tua Topa in biakna a piak ding a kisam kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama pumpi tawh mite ading khatvei bek a piak hang ahi hi.
Thukham in a khial thei mite siampi-uk za-ah a koih hi. Thukham nungah kiciamna thu piakkholhna thu in, a tawntung kicingin a om Tapa a koih hi.
